versions.short: The bill would allow tribal courts to be treated as courts that can issue search warrants for electronic communications and records held by service providers, placing them on the same footing as federal and state courts under the Stored Communications Act. It would also let tribal governments count as governmental entities under that law, extend the same delayed-notice and civil-action provisions to tribal courts and tribes, and allow tribal court warrants to be used to obtain video tape rental or sale records under the federal privacy law for those records.
